title: A web design and development studio
description: Altruvex designs and builds custom websites and web applications. How projects run, the standards we build to and the price ranges are all published on this site.

what.value: Custom websites and web applications, end to end: website design, website and web app development, technical audits of existing builds, and maintenance after launch.

shipped.value: Online stores for two lighting retailers, and this site. Each one is public, so you can open it and check it yourself.

languages.value: Every language your site needs, right-to-left included, designed and engineered together from the first wireframe, not added at the end.

build.value: Custom code on Next.js, not a theme or a page builder. The performance, accessibility and security targets we build to are published in full.

process.value: Five phases: discovery, wireframe, design, development and launch. You approve the structure and then the design before development starts.

pricing.value: Ranges are published and every estimate is broken down before the contract. Payment is by milestone, and the code, designs and accounts pass to you at final payment.

where.value: Working remotely with clients wherever they are.

name.value: altr-, as in altruism: when your interest and ours disagree, the decision follows yours.

principles.title: Four commitments,
principles.count: {count, plural, one {{n} principle} other {{n} principles}} · open any

writing.title: Decisions are agreed in writing.
writing.body: Scope, changes and approvals are written down before work moves on, so both sides work from the same record.
writing.cost: Writing it down takes longer than agreeing on a call.

scope.title: We advise cutting scope that won't pay back.
scope.body: If a page, a feature, or an entire phase will not earn back what it costs to build, we say so before it is quoted — not after it ships.
scope.cost: The recommendation that removes a feature removes a line from our own invoice.

pricing.title: Price changes are agreed before work, never added after.
pricing.body: Estimates are broken down before the contract, not defended after it. If scope changes, the change order arrives before the work starts — not with the final invoice.
pricing.cost: A number fixed in advance is a bet against our own estimate, and we pay when it is wrong.

ownership.title: It is yours at final payment.
ownership.body: At final payment, repositories, domains and pipelines are in your name, documented for the engineer after us. Nothing is engineered to make leaving difficult.
ownership.cost: We keep no leverage over a client who decides to walk.

fit.title: Who this is for,
fitItems: A business that needs its site to take orders, bookings or inquiries
Customers who read more than one language, right-to-left included
Someone who wants to own the code outright
A team that can review and approve each phase
notItems: A theme with a new logo by Friday
A project with no one to make decisions
A fixed price before anyone has looked at the problem
